setup.response: 0.1-um boxcar in wavelength, edges softened by a Gaussian of 0.005 um

paper_floors_joint.note: measurement covariance = the adopted per-element floors (diagonal, in OD); gas, group, T, CFC and response states kept with their priors

joint_band.note: window: gas state + line covariance; 32 outer elements: the paper's empirical floors as per-shell rows

snr_scan.note: plateau = fixed database term (independent per-line scatter at sigma_eta_base), not reducible by averaging occultations

vertical_conversion.formula: dz* = g^2 sigma_white^2 / (8 R_E (coherent extinction term)^2)

atlas_test.figure: figures/scisat_ace_atlas_874.png (round 70: both sides in the element observable on 0.02-um boxcars)
atlas_test.note: tropical 16-20 km bin, 18-km tangent, US-standard profiles (N2O, CH4, H2O, CFC-12 at climatology) scaled by one O3 amplitude fitted on the 9.2-um element; the atlas transmittance (0.02 cm^-1 resolution, oversampled at 0.0025 cm^-1) is formed into the same boxcar element observable; residual = measured minus predicted at 8.80 um

monte_carlo_note: truth: O3 nodes from the 30 %/6-km prior (clipped 0.2-3), N2O 5 %, T 2 K, CFC 3 %, source-group scalings at the code midpoints, independent per-line scatter sigma_eta, sulfate amplitudes x0.5-2 (log-uniform), PSD r_med +-20 %, sigma +-10 %, photon noise at S=2000 (exp(y/2) growth), element response shifted by N(0, 0.003 um) and edges softened by |N(0, 0.003 um)| in the truth, both co-retrieved with a 0.005-um prior; retrieval: 8 damped Gauss-Newton iterations of the nonlinear element model from the prior. Masses in Tg per 0.5-km shell at 20 km (slant amplitude x rho).
